d:
Samay Raina’s remark on contestant Salma Deewani’s cousin has sparked a fresh controversy.
During India’s Got Latent Season 2, Raina joked that Salma’s cousin was her “husband”. Free Press Journal
The comment triggered criticism on social media over alleged religious stereotyping.
Salma Deewani is the stage character of Hyderabad-based performer Bhagyashree Tarke.
The controversy has reignited debate over comedy, stereotypes and the limits of humour.
